items.title: Jotai 3.0 Ships as a Modernized, ESM-Only Package That Drops Legacy Builds and Deprecated APIs
items.blurb: Jotai, an atomic state management library for React, has released version 3.0.0, now exclusively using ES modules. It maintains backward compatibility but removes some deprecated APIs. Migration is straightforward for most users.

items.title: Meta Open-Sources Astryx, its Agent-Ready React Design System
items.blurb: Meta recently announced the beta release of Astryx, an open-source React design system developed internally over eight years.

items.title: Vidact: Compiles React Components Down to Direct DOM Code
items.blurb: Vidact compiles React components into direct DOM code. No Virtual DOM, no React runtime.
